mechanism: Febuxostat may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of guanfacine, potentially increasing guanfacine plasma concentrations and enhancing alpha-2 adrenergic effects including hypotension and bradycardia.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider guanfacine dose reduction if hypotensive or bradycardic effects emerge; alternative xanthine oxidase inhibitor (allopurinol) may be considered if interaction becomes problematic.
